So the test expects the function to return the combined correlation DataFrame (not an Axes), while the task prompt says "return a combined heatmap". Reference returns combined_corr. So contract ambiguity: prompt says output the combined heatmap; test checks shape of returned object. This is a previous contract candidate "axes_vs_matrix_return".
